column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-19 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. This file replaces the retired committed enumeration,
# which was a generated projection of the gate rather than an opinion the gate is checked
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the validation-locus entries and mutant names the run read
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase19/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase19_gate.py implements
# The 54 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. A rejection surface takes
# both halves of its evidence where both exist — the pinned negative that must be refused
# and the generated class that must keep firing at its coverage floor.
# The response codec keeps one surface, not two. `UiBindError` carries a single
# `ContractMismatch PortId` for the request/response pair, so the only thing that
# distinguishes the response side is the mutant that swaps it. That mutant *is* this
# surface's evidence; giving it a second surface of its own would report one observation as
# two independent results. The other six mutants attack foreclosures that also have their
# own pinned negative, so they keep their own surfaces beside those negatives.
